_comment: Pokéathlon museum: Potential room + the tips guy.
0: This the “Potential” room.\nIt show the infinite potential\fof homies AND people.
1: Only Pokéathletes who held\nthe best record in every event\fcan come in here.\rKeep grindin' toward\nbreakin' every record out there.
3:
You a REAL Pokéathlete to make it
in here!But you still got a long way to be
the Top Pokéathlete.Want me to put you on to some
special techniques? {YESNO 0}
4: Ayo, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!\nYou got anything else\fyou wanna know about? {YESNO 0}
5: Ayo, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!\nYou got anything else\fyou wanna know about? {YESNO 0}
8: In Hurdle Dash, timin' is everything.\rYour homies pick up speed\nif you let 'em wait till the last\fsecond before they jump the Hurdles.\r
9:
Pennant Capture...It ain't just the Pennants on the
beach, it's the ones other homies already grabbed.Run into 'em from behind, they fall,
you snatch their Pennants.That's how the pros do it.
Smash n Grab. Totally legal here.
10:
The key is pushin' other homies out
of the Circles...which is obvious.Actually, your homies push harder
if you pick the right moment to tell 'em to push.So you might push back strong
homies if you keep tellin' 'em to push.
11:
Block Smash ain't just smashin'.You ever notice lil cracks in the
Blocks?Hit them cracks and they break
REAL fast!Hit cracks back to back and your
homies feel GREAT.One more thing...When you switch, flick your homie
upward. Quicker switch. Like a skateboard trick. Kinda.
12: Disc Catch is about how long you can\nwait before you catch the Discs.\rBird homies can move around in the\nair, so it's easier to catch Discs\fif you build a team of bird homies.\r
13: Lamp Jump ain't just about jumpin'.\rThere's three homies bouncin'\ntogether, so one homie can't jump\fright if another one come down right\fwhen it tryna go up.\rLettin' 'em jump at the right time\nis the key.\r
14:
Relay Run need well-timed switchin'.You notice homies start to
sweat a lil when they tired?That also mean they slowed down
a LOT.Don't let 'em sweat.Switch before they start sweatin',
that's the key.
15:
You ain't gettin' to the top just
tacklin' a lot in Ring Drop. You know a “Body Attack”?That's what I call it, anyway...Your homie can jump while movin'
forward.Body Attack the others and drop
'em right off the Ring! WWE style. Respect the elbow.
16:
Snow Throw ain't just about throwin'.You makin' sure the Snowballs
is big?Bigger Snowballs got a better
chance of knockin' other homies down.You can also block Snowballs
from hittin' your homies by havin' your homies hold on to some Snowballs.
17:
Goal Roll need real Pokéathlete
skills.The situation change every second,
but stay calm when you give your homies orders.Positionin' is key.I recommend keepin' one at your own
Goal to guard it--one in the middle of the field to stay flexible and one in front of the Goal you tryna roll the ball into.
18: Hope you become a Top Pokéathlete.\nGood luck! Stretch! Hydrate!\fCall your mama!
19: People who won the Pokéathlon\n100 times get honored here for\fsettin' a new,\flegendary record.
20: It's a hard Pokégear to honor\nyour 100th Pokéathlon W.\rThat's your model!\nIt's a special Pokégear with\fthe Pokéathlon logo on the back.
21: Pokéathletes who came in first\nin every Pokéathlon event\f50 times get honored here for\ftheir crazy power and the\fbirth of a new legend.
22: It's a FIRE Nap Sack to honor your\n50th W in every Pokéathlon event.\rIt's your model Nap Sack!\nThe engravin' say, “Stay on Top.”\fBurlap never looked this good.
24: DODRIO: KEEWN!\n(All three heads agree: you sweaty.)
